---
title: "hotmap"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-25"
---

```{r}
install.packages("pheatmap")
library(pheatmap)
setwd("C:/Users/安慕希/Documents")    
inputFile="Eis hotmap.txt" 
groupFile="Eis hotmap group.txt" 
outFile="Eis heatmap.pdf"  
rt <- read.table(inputFile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
ann <- read.table(groupFile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
p <- pheatmap(rt,
              annotation = ann,
              cluster_cols = TRUE,
              cluster_rows = TRUE,
              color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(50),
              show_colnames = TRUE, 
              show_rownames = TRUE,
              scale = "row", 
              fontsize = 8, 
              fontsize_row = 6, 
              fontsize_col = 6,
              border_color = NA)
pdf(outFile, width = 6, height = 5.5)
print(p)
dev.off()

```


## R Markdown

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```
